categories.main_business_segments: Hiecise Precision Equipment Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and service of high-end precision grinding equipment, primarily focusing on CNC roll grinding machines. Key product lines include fully automatic CNC roll grinding machines, sub-micron high-end composite grinding products, precision thread grinding machines, precision CNC linear guideway grinding machines, and ultra-precision CNC curved (flat) surface grinding machines. The company also provides maintenance and retrofit services and spare parts related to grinding equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as direct-drive spindle systems, high-precision interpolation for multi-axis grinding, and self-developed intelligent grinding CNC systems. It has developed proprietary high-precision control algorithms enabling sub-micron accuracy and integrates flexible intelligent manufacturing systems with MES and PLM for digitalized production. The manufacturing process emphasizes precision machining, digital and intelligent production lines, and in-house production of key components to replace imports.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hiecise serves primarily industrial customers in steel, non-ferrous metals, paper, light textile, robotics, automotive parts, aerospace, semiconductor, and precision instrument manufacturing sectors. Major clients include leading domestic steel groups such as Baowu, Ansteel, Hebei Steel, Shandong Steel, and Shougang Group. The company also targets emerging markets in India, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam, focusing on high-end manufacturing industries requiring precision grinding equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with its headquarters and manufacturing base in Kunshan, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded its market reach internationally to emerging Asian markets including India, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam. Domestic sales account for over 90% of revenue, with growing export sales contributing nearly 8%.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hiecise operates primarily in the midstream segment of the manufacturing supply chain, producing high-precision grinding equipment and related components used by downstream manufacturers in metal processing and precision industries. It also provides aftermarket services including maintenance, retrofit, and spare parts supply, integrating upstream R&D and manufacturing with downstream customer support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-precision grinding technology, focusing on breakthroughs in core components and intelligent CNC systems to achieve import substitution. It invests heavily in R&D, collaborating with top universities like Tsinghua University to develop advanced grinding solutions for emerging industries such as robotics, semiconductors, aerospace, and new energy. Strategic initiatives include expanding product applications, enhancing digital and green manufacturing, and deepening industry partnerships to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-end CNC grinding machines, maintenance and retrofit services, and sales of spare parts. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery, installation, and customer acceptance of equipment. It also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies, but these are non-recurring and not core to its business model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hiecise is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer and innovator in the high-end precision grinding equipment sector, breaking foreign monopolies in CNC roll grinding machines. It competes with international giants from Germany and Japan but has established a strong foothold in China’s industrial mother machine market. The company is recognized as a national champion and a specialized, innovative 'little giant' enterprise, emphasizing technological leadership and import substitution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 446 million, a slight decline of 6.92% from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 62 million, down 47.36%. Total assets stood at RMB 2.12 billion with steady growth. Despite short-term profit fluctuations, the company maintains strong cash flow and continues to invest significantly in R&D, reflecting a stable medium-sized enterprise with growth potential in high-end manufacturing equipment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hiecise offers high-precision, fully automated CNC grinding equipment with performance metrics comparable to world-class products, emphasizing sub-micron accuracy, high efficiency, and intelligent control. Its unique value lies in proprietary core technologies, self-developed CNC systems, and comprehensive lifecycle services including customization, installation, and maintenance. The company’s products enable customers to achieve superior grinding precision and efficiency, supporting critical industries and reducing reliance on imported high-end equipment.
